detours.why: West Campus's residence quads are closed in by joined Gothic buildings and OSM maps few of the arches through them, so walks leave each quad by its mapped openings and go round to the main quad.

Wilson Recreation Center and the Intramural Building sit below Towerview Road with their mapped doors on the service drive behind them; no mapped path leads down to them from the quads, so walks go down Wannamaker Drive and round by that drive.
